svg.title: XDRProof pipeline
svg.desc: Inputs: the hazard registry (78 hazards) says what to target; recipes drive a standalone stellar-core v30.0.0, pinned by image digest, to emit rare shapes; ledger history adds mined variants. The corpus (263 entries, 634 variants) holds the bytes and the facts a correct reader must return. Verify, Oracle and Coverage prove it with independent readers; it reaches 417 of 499 union arms. Replay feeds every corpus ledger to wallet-backend main (618 of 634 handled, 0 halted) and to the builds before and after each fix. Conformance runs the corpus and test vectors through 6 JavaScript, WebAssembly, Rust, Go and Python SDK builds, and the fixed-bug regressions through 5 older releases. The linter, xplint, checks Go indexer source for the three ingestion mistakes: 4 findings on wallet-backend main, 0 with XDRProof's two patches. Planned: a GitHub Action and the hardening guide.
